title: The Oak and the Reeds
summary: A colossal oak mocked the fragile reeds that bent before the gentlest breeze....
full_text:
A colossal oak mocked the fragile reeds that bent before the gentlest breeze.

That night, a tempest swept through the valley. The reeds yielded to the gale and remained rooted in peace, while the rigid oak stood proud until his trunk snapped, casting the fallen giant into the river.
moral: Better to bow with the storm than break in rigid pride.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
